#summary Google App Engine example.

= Gae Example =

This example demonstrates using Producer/Consumer messaging with HTTP polling running on the Google App Engine platform.

[http://amfastchat.appspot.com/flash/chat.html Example demo]

The example is located in SVN within the [http://code.google.com/p/amfast/source/browse/#svn/trunk/examples/gae examples/gae] directory.

= Setup GAE =

 * [http://code.google.com/appengine/downloads.html#Google_App_Engine_SDK_for_Python Download] and install the Google App Engine SDK.

= Setup Application =

 * Check out the example's source code from [http://code.google.com/p/amfast/source/browse/#svn/trunk/examples/gae svn] into a folder named 'chat' with the following command:
{{{
svn checkout http://amfast.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/examples/gae chat
}}}

 * Python extensions cannot be compiled for Google App Engine. You will need to use a pure-python encoder and decoder.
  * Download and extract the latest version of [http://pyamf.org/wiki/Download PyAmf]
  * Copy the 'pyamf' folder from the PyAmf distribution into the 'chat' folder.

= Run the app =
 * Use the following command to launch the app:
{{{
google_appengine/dev_appserver.py chat/
}}}
